fields.why: Tables 1 and 3 show test positivity (row %) for each of 5 race/ethnicity and 5 age groups; VE by age compares only 18–49 vs ≥50 years, so it adds no entry.
Race/ethnicity and age are the SPDs with 3+ groups shown in Tables 1 and 3; sex has two levels.

The SMDs are non-inferential balance measures, not tests across the groups. The flagged CI-nonoverlap rule applies only to VE comparisons across periods and doses, not across race or age groups, so the flag is a false alarm.

brief_issues: Section F does not say how to treat a single multi-category SMD with a 0.20 threshold (a non-inferential, omnibus-like balance measure across SPD levels); side by side is the closest value.
